def is_valid_function_name(name: str, invalid_names: set) -> bool:
    """Validate function name to filter false positives."""
    if not name or len(name) < 2:
        return False
    if name.lower() in invalid_names:
        return False
    if not (name[0].isalpha() or name[0] == '_'):
        return False
    return True

                    "type": param_type,
                    "default": default,

                })
